events.description: FeaturingPeter LiuTom ZappiaMalachi FoxJoe MahoneyShaunak GodkhindiNatan BadalovDerrell MeyersOriginally from Buffalo, New York, Malachi Fox is a comedian, producer, and the founder of No Cent Comedy, an independent comedy showcase dedicated to creating unforgettable live comedy experiences while spotlighting both rising talent and established performers.As the creator of No Cent Comedy, Malachi has produced successful showcases in Buffalo, New York, and North Carolina, with the brand continuing to expand into new markets across the country. His productions are built on strong lineups, high-energy entertainment, and a commitment to creating opportunities for comedians while delivering memorable experiences for audiences.As a performer, Malachi has appeared on stages throughout the East Coast and West Coast, performing in numerous comedy clubs across New York City and beyond. He has also been featured in the Comedy Mob Festival and the Baltimore Comedy Festival, continuing to build a reputation as both a dynamic comic and a respected independent producer.Whether he’s behind the scenes producing shows or on stage behind the microphone, Malachi’s mission remains the same: to build community through comedy, create opportunities for comedians, and bring people together through unforgettable nights of laughter.Joe Mahoney is an NYC comic from Long Island who can play to many different crowds. His clever writing has earned him countless spots at the legendary Comic Strip Live and feature work on the road. He’s appeared on Adult Swim and Compound Media.Natan Badalov is a New York-based comedian and writer. He emigrated from Uzbekistan to the United States in the early 90’s. Since then, he has been featured on Adult Swim, New York Comedy Festival, Chosen Comedy Festival, Funnymmigrants Comedy Festival, Laughing Devil Comedy Festival, as well as many others.Natan created and wrote 'Park West’, an animated web series about his time in yeshiva. He also co-starred and wrote ‘Heartbreakers’, a web series about two roommates that help each other navigate their breakups and find love. His work has been featured on Channel 101 NY, American Jewish Film Festival, Alternative Film Festival, Flickfair Film Festival, Polish International Film Festival, and ANIMATOR - a Polish Animated Film Competition, Smiles Film Festival, and Animae Digital Film Festival.Natan’s first solo show ‘Connect The Dots’ was part of the The New York Comedy Festival and Rochester Fringe Festival, and he is currently touring it across the country. For more, you can follow him on socials @natanbadalov.

events.title: Subhah Agarwal, Shane Torres, Eva Evans, Tom Zappia, Neko White
events.description: Prime-Time Comedy in Brooklyn!FEATURING SPECIAL GUEST COMEDIANS...Lineup BelowFeaturingSubhah AgarwalShane TorresEva EvansTom ZappiaNeko WhiteShane Torres is a standup comedian, writer, podcaster, and sometimes actor who lives in Brooklyn, New York. As a standup comedian Shane has appeared on CONAN (twice), THE LATE SHOW WITH STEPHEN COLBERT, NBC’S LAST COMIC STANDING, HALF HOUR SPECIAL WITH COMEDY CENTRAL, and THIS WEEK FROM THE CELLAR on Comedy Central just to name a few. He released his debut album "Established 1981" with Comedy Central records to rave reviews in 2018. You can see him touring all around the world at comedy clubs, concert venues, and some of the most prestigious festivals. Shane has been heard on popular podcasts such as BERTCAST, COMEDY BANG BANG, ALL FANTASY EVERYTHING, GUYS WE FUCKED, SAVAGE LOVE PODCAST, DOUG LOVES MOVIES, RISK and a slew of more. His podcast NO ACCOUNTING FOR TASTE with Kyle Kinane is available via ALL THINGS COMEDY wherever you get your podcasts. Shane has been seen acting alongside household names for NBC’S RED NOSE DAY and on IFC’S COMEDY BANG BANG. In 2019 Shane was one of a handful of comedians invited to perform on Will Smith’s THIS JOKA. Shane has also hosted his own series for Comedy Central called SHANE TORRES CONQUERS YOUR FEARS and a show for Paramount Plus named HOW GOOD CAN IT GET WITH SHANE TORRES. Shane has also been seen as a panelist on multiple television shows across a variety of networks. He has been reviewed by numerous media outlets including The New York Times, Onion AV Club, GQ UK, and more. “Mr. Torres has a laconic drawling delivery with deliberate pacing, placing him firmly in the tradition of dry deadpan specialists like Tig Notaro and Todd Barry. But his style is warmer, relying on punchlines with corkscrew turns that have moments of vulnerability and even melancholy.” — The New York Times.Subhah Agarwal has brought an honesty to her comedy that will leave you saying "I didn't need to know that." Subhah has written for Netflix’s “Arsenio Hall” limited series, the "Plan B" movie on Hulu," and The Jim Jefferies Show"on Comedy Central, amongst others. You can also catch her jokes live at stand up comedy clubs across the country. If you don't want to leave your couch, you can see her late night debut on NBC's "A Little Late With Lilly Singh." She's also appeared on season three of HBO's "Westworld", "General Hospital," TruTv's sketch comedy "Friends of the People", and as herself on MTV2, Comedy Central, and Gotham Comedy Live.Hailing from Brooklyn and Jamaica, Eva Evans is a comedian that has been described as “the true definition of a hustler.” She recently showcased in the coveted Netflix Introducing showcase, recorded in Los Angeles May 2025. She’s been featured on Sway in the Morning at Caroline’s and The Wendy Williams Show, BET, and at the request of Senator Jessie Williams performed at the 2018 Women’s Empowerment Awards. Eva has performed in the Netflix is a Joke Festival, Laughing Skull Festival, Harlem Comedy Festival, and Manhattan Comedy Festival; and was the only female comedian to regularly perform in front of detainees at Riker's Island.Funny, smart, fresh, and magnetic, Neko White is a star. A comedian born and raised in Harlem, Neko has brought his unique perspective and sharp comedy from New York to international audiences. Beginning his career at just fourteen years old, the then high school freshman was sitting in class when a teacher asked, “Does anyone have a talent?” Something in Neko’s mind said, “Go tell jokes!“ He went up in front of his classmates and it worked. And, as they say, the rest is history. As a stand-up, Neko has been featured on Netflix’s "Pete Davidson Presents: The Best Friends," Cracked Comedy Club, TruTV’s "Laff Tracks," AXS TV’s "Gotham Comedy Live," STARZ’s "New York’s Funniest," and Kevin Hart’s LOL Network. He was named one of the "New Faces" in the Just For Laughs Festival, performed in Netflix is a Joke Festival, and won Carolines’ prestigious March Madness competition. Neko released a comedy album titled "Marscellus," then produced one of the most original filmed specials in recent memory with his self-released "Dark Out." Shot with no audience, a pitch-black background, and recorded with an old-fashioned microphone, Neko’s special received critical acclaim. One publication said "Dark Out" made Neko one of the “innovators changing comedy.” Neko also self-produced his first hour special, "Neko White: Introducing Me.” He was the subject of the award-winning documentary, “One Mic.”Neko is an accomplished television personality. He hosted Vice News’ popular series, "How To Be A Person" and has been a regular guest on MTV2’s "Hip Hop Hollywood Squares" and Comedy Central’s "Dark Humor." Neko made his film acting debut in the movie, "Midlife."

events.title: Warm Sake Tasting Class and Brewery Tour
events.description:
Exploring sake temperature and pairing — warm sake, done right, is a revelation.
For a long time, warm sake has gotten a bad rap! But it can be absolutely delicious when you pick the right sake and the right temperature. Join us for this exciting exploration of sake temperature and the joys of warming sake — the perfect way to explore the subtle umami and richness of premium sake.
We’ll contrast chilled sake with the same sake served warm, and enjoy carefully selected food pairings to round out the tasting flight. In all, we’ll taste five kinds of sake, each paired with a delicious bite to bring out the flavors and textures. As always, this class includes a behind-the-scenes brewery tour to see how sake is made at NY State’s first sake brewery.

events.title: Wait, What’s Sri Lanka? - **THIS IS A COMEDY SPECIAL TAPING**
events.description: Buying a ticket means you consent to potentially being on camera. ARRIVAL INFO:Please arrive early to be seated and experience any of the pre-built pre-show. We recommend showing up at least 30 minutes before show time. Once the show begins there is no late seating because the cameras will be rolling. Wait, What’s Sri Lanka? is a one hour stand-up special, written by Shenuque and directed by Sunny Laprade, this show is for anyone who has ever felt invisible. The show explores the joy of embracing all parts of your identity while navigating the pain of not feeling seen. Shenuque uses a narrative stand-up style to talk about their life through the lens of being Sri Lankan and how that intersects with their other identities. The show reveals how interconnected we all are. Regardless of whether or not you're Sri Lankan, this show is for you. Topics include race, gender, sexuality, and of course, aunties. If you enjoy stand-up comedy that weaves together humor with a compelling narrative, you will enjoy this show.All graphics are designed by: Elliot Davis.Music by: DJ UshkaOriginal Music by: Roshane KarunaratneBio:Shenuque is a Sri Lankan American comedian born and raised on Staten Island. Their stand-up is infused with a passion for storytelling and an enrapturing stage presence. They are currently touring their debut stand-up special, Wait, What’s Sri Lanka?, a show for anyone who has ever felt invisible. They’ve graced the stage in Off-Broadway productions and contributed their writing talents to HBO Max. They’ve worked as a director for the Murmuration Theater Company and co-founded the award-winning podcast studio Many Sided Media, where you can regularly hear their voice acting on the show My First Dungeon. Audiences have said that Shenuque is like if Hasan Minhaj, Tiffany Haddish, and John Mulaney were in a polycule and didn’t let Shenuque in, so he modeled his comedy after all of them.

events.title: Movie Screening of Prince – Sign O’ the Times
events.description:
Get It Right Music in association with BK One Productions is proud to present our late summer/early fall music documentary and horror film movies (yes, those two things go together, and yes, we ARE wondering why you are asking!). Watch fan favorites on our 16-foot wide LED video wall and enjoy the film in full concert sound!
Sign o’ the Times is a 1987 American concert film directed by, scored by, and starring Prince. The film features the band that accompanied Prince on the 1987 Sign o’ the Times Tour: dancer Cat Glover, keyboardist Boni Boyer, bassist Levi Seacer Jr., guitarist Miko Weaver, drummer Sheila E., keyboardist Doctor Fink, and the horn section of Eric Leeds and Atlanta Bliss; Wally Safford and Greg Brooks (of The Bodyguards from the Revolution era) reprised their roles as dancers, vocalists and comic foils.
Event Info
Film: Prince – Sign O’ the Times
Date: October 15th, 2026
Doors: 7:00pm
Screening: 7:30pm
RSVP: Free or strongly encourage guaranteed $20 two-drink included RSVP.
Address: Industry City Bandshell Stage, Courtyard 1/2 at Industry City in Brooklyn, New York between 36th and 37th street and 2nd and 3rd Avenues.
ENTER 238 36th Street, Brooklyn, NY on your GPS device
The selection of music documentaries was curated by audience vote from our summer concert series and the horror movies came from out of our brains!
Seating for these screenings are limited to 150 people or so (with slightly more for the music docs so peeps can throw down appropriately.
Fans who purchase the 2 drink guaranteed RSVP will be guaranteed entry, natch! So you will save money at the bar, AND make sure you aren’t shut out!
This event is free with RSVP, ages 8 and up are welcome. There will be drink specials, all night, as well.
Limited seating (about 100-125 seats), tons of standing room. No strollers.
No outside beverages. There will be drink specials all night long from our courtyard bar.
While we do our best to gauge the number of RSVPs, entry is still on a first-come, first-served basis, so please arrive early! Once we hit capacity, we will only let people in on an in and out basis! Fans who purchase the 2 drink RSVP at check-out will be guaranteed entry!
The venue is located in an open-air courtyard featuring a full concert sound stage. Fans can get affordable drinks from the venue’s bar and order food from over 17 options inside the adjoining food hall.
How to get here:
Take the D, N, R lines to 36th street station in Brooklyn and walk west one block to Industry City. 3 stops from Manhattan. 30 minutes from Herald Square.
From Long Island, take the LIRR to Atlantic Terminal then take the D, N or R train to 36th street.

events.title: Corinne Fisher, James Mattern, Dara Jemmott, Mariel Jimenez, Tom Zappia, Zahid Dewji, Napoleon Emill
events.description: Prime-Time Comedy in Brooklyn!FEATURING SPECIAL GUEST COMEDIANS...Lineup BelowFeaturingCorinne FisherJames MatternDara JemmottMariel JimenezTom ZappiaZahid DewjiNapoleon EmillCORINNE FISHER is a stand-up comedian, writer, director & actor originally from Union, NJ and currently residing in New York City. Most recently, she directed the debut comedy special from her and herlongtime comedy partner, Krystyna Hutchinson. The special is set to air in February 2022. The duo is most known for co-creating and co-hosting their groundbreaking, genre-creating GUYS WE F*CKED: The Anti Slut-Shaming podcast — a vulnerable firsthand look into modern female sexuality from a comedic perspective — which began tearing up charts in December 2013. Over eight years later, the show boasts millions of listeners nationally and internationally and has inspired dozens of female-led comedy/sexuality shows. The podcast has hit #1 on the iTunes comedy charts multiple times and has been featured in Vogue, Interview, Esquire, The Huffington Post, The Daily Beast, Splitsider, Mother Jones, Perez Hilton, Elle, A.V. Club, E! News, People, US Magazine, Bust, CNN, and The Village Voice as well as on Sirius Radio, and NBC’s Last Call with Carson Daly. High-profile guests include Amanda Knox, Amber Rose, and Fran Drescher. The podcast was also turned into a book by HarperCollins entitled F*CKED: Being Sexually Explorative and Self-Confident in a World That’s Screwed and the duo was asked to give a TEDx talk exploring topics from their show.Corinne first made a splash in the comedy scene with her debut one-woman show Corinne Fisher: I STALK YOU (Dir. David Crabb) which had a run at The Peoples Improv Theater in the Summer of 2010 and was a featured show in Time Out New York. Since then, she has been a regular on the stand-up scene selling out shows at world-famous clubs like The Comedy Store, New York Comedy Club, The Stand, and Caroline’s on Broadway and theaters such as The Wilbur in Boston, the Athenaeum inChicago, and the Tribeca Performing Arts Center in New York City. Fisher has also been selected to perform at the prestigious Just For Laughs Comedy Festival in both Montreal and Toronto, Moontower Comedy Festival, Boston Comedy Festival, and cult favorite Skankfest. She’s been seen on FOX’s LAUGHS and her show with fellow comic Katie Hannigan THE COMEDIENNE PROJECT (Dir. Ted Alexandro) was selected for the NYC Fringe Festival.Fisher remains an innovator in podcasting, having co-created the WITHOUT A COUNTRY podcast which she currently co-hosts with comedian Shayne Smith, a weekly news shows that covers stories using aslew of sources from various political perspectives. She also previously co-hosted and co-created TWO LESS LONELY GIRLS, a podcast for adult Justin Bieber fans with comedian Rosebud Baker.Right now, Corinne is working on writing and producing several projects including the cartoon series MYSTERY SQUAD GALS created by Ryan Duff. In an unexpected plot twist, she also took over her Dad’sbaseball card and horror collectibles store, Perfectly Centered, in 2021.James Mattern is a nationally headlining comic and media personality, who has quickly become one of the most beloved emcees in New York. James has released two albums, "No Segues" in 2019 and "The Check Spot" in 2021, the latter of which debuted at #1 on iTunes Comedy Charts and was voted Interrobang’s “Album of the Year” in 2021. The development of "The Check Spot" album was recorded from its conception and later released as a documentary film by the same name on YouTube on June 3, 2021.James has warmed up audiences on a number of TV shows in both New York and Los Angeles, including Netflix’s "Patriot Act with Hasan Minhaj," ABC’s "The View," NBC’s "Bring the Funny," Netflix’s "The Break with Michelle Wolf," and ABC’s "The Chew." He has also appeared on PlutoTV’s "Kevin Hart Presents Comedy in Color," MSG Network’s "The Bracket," Manhattan Neighborhood Network’s "Chris Gethard Presents," Fox Sports "One's Garbage Time with Katie Nolan," WWE Network's "The List," and MSG Network’s "People Talking Sports," to name a few.Currently, James can be heard as a co-hosts "The SDR (Sex, Drugs, and Rock & Roll) Show" on G.A.S. Digital.Zahid Dewji is an NYC based comedian. He was a former staff writer on NBC’s The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, as well as the head writer on OFTV’s Roast of Bert Kreischer & The Roast of Whitney Cummings. Born in Queens, NY to East African Indian immigrants, the "Z-man" (as no one calls him) was raised in Houston where he began his comedy career and quickly became a Texas favorite. Zahid has toured the country with comedy icon Whitney Cummings as well as internet sensation Noel Miller and has been featured on countless comedy festivals including Oddball Comedy Fest, Laughing Skull and Moontower Comedy Festival. His debut special “Where is God?” was released in 2023 with Don’t Tell Comedy. He also has a new set filmed with OFTV available to stream exclusively on Only Fans (yes, really).

events.title: Liam Dalton, Tom Zappia, Dennis Rooney, Whitney Chanel, Salma Zaky
events.description: TGIF Comedy in Brooklyn! FEATURING SPECIAL GUEST COMEDIANS...(Lineup coming soon)FeaturingLiam DaltonTom ZappiaDennis RooneyWhitney ChanelSalma ZakyLiam Dalton is a New York City based comedian, actor and writer, born and raised in Queens. His conversational style mixes observational humor with personal stories of growing up the only boy in a big Irish Catholic household. Fresh off of performing on Bert Kreischer’s “Fully Loaded“ cruise, Liam performed on the Impractical Jokers cruise and the Netflix is a Joke comedy festival in Los Angeles. He has opened for big acts like Mark Normand, Rachel Feinstein and Cipha Sounds. He just finished his stint as a radio personality on New York radio station 94.7 the block. When he’s not touring the country or seas, Liam performs all over New York City and uploads sketches to his social media daily. Whitney Chanel is a New York City comedian whose work has been featured on VH1, Bravo, Tubi, BuzzFeed, and The Sweet Spot. Known for her sharp storytelling and authentic perspective, Whitney creates a space where audiences can laugh, relate, and see their own life experiences reflected on stage. Her comedy is honest, engaging, and unapologetically real, inviting people to embrace their authentic selves while finding humor in everyday life.Originally from the Bay Area, Salma Zaky moved to Los Angeles to attend college, where she began her comedy journey. Salma has filmed a mini stand-up special with OnlyFans on OFTV (unfortunately clothed), as well as a Don't Tell taping. She now resides in Brooklyn, NY to take her anxiety and career to new heights.
